analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free is caused by storing raw pointers to elements of decoded->extra_channels() while continuing to grow that same vector. In FinalizeFrameDecoding, the loop emplaces a new extra channel and immediately pushes &decoded->extra_channels().back() into extra_channels. Subsequent emplace_back can reallocate decoded->extra_channels(), invalidating previously stored pointers. These dangling pointers are later dereferenced in ImageBlender::PrepareBlending (ZeroFillPlane -> Row/VoidRow), producing the UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered on frame-finalization paths that enter blending (NeedsBlending true, skip_blending false) with multiple extra channels so decoded->extra_channels().emplace_back(...) in the loop can cause vector reallocation after at least one pointer has already been saved in extra_channels. Data flow: fuzzer input -> decode pipeline -> FrameDecoder::Flush/FinalizeFrame -> FinalizeFrameDecoding builds extra_channels pointer vector -> passes it to blender.PrepareBlending, which accesses stale Plane pointers.
